about: Read by AFK Realm (https://github.com/aspollon/AFK-Realm) when it builds the server. Without AFK Realm, apply the patches by hand: see README.md.

patches.name: Bots keep their bags
patches.why: mod-playerbots empties the bags of every random bot every 10 to 40 minutes and after every death. Without this change the bots never have anything to sell.

patches.name: No crash on level-scaled loot
patches.why: Since CoA core #6403 a bot that loots a level-scaled item ends the server. Left out by itself as soon as mod-playerbots has the fix.

settings.why: Bots only gather ore and herbs they pass within this distance. With the default of 15 yards hardly any reach the auction house.
